verdict: accept diagnostic evidence; no production lighting change justified
visual_findings: Baseline, frozen occluders and restored comparisons are pixel-exact.
Companion artwork and HUD remain intact.
Disabling shadows visibly leaks light through terrain; disabling lights removes intended illumination. Neither is a lossless candidate.
localization: Occlusion refresh costs approximately 0.94–1.02 ms per frame in baseline, with approximately 4.5 rebuilds per second while occupancy remains unchanged.
Refresh cost persists with all lights disabled.
Combined lighting has measurable cost in several windows, but the evidence does not establish the main remaining bottleneck or reliably rank lighting components.
Hard shadows provide only small gains; PCF alone is not established as the cause.
limitations: Substantial order and timing drift; retain repeat-2 lights-off first-window 35.70 FPS outlier.
GPU timers unavailable; no GPU attribution.
Mac WebKit results do not establish physical phone cause or performance benefit.
Frozen occluders are a diagnostic condition, not safe general gameplay behavior.

next_trial.condition: Apply only where solidity depends solely on blocks.has(cell), preserving other terrain branches and coverage/emitter invalidation.
next_trial.validation: Verify unchanged visuals and correct invalidation for value-only damage, insertion/deletion and equal-count key replacement; measure actual benefit.
next_trial.caveat: Keys allocation and hashing remain O(n); no performance gain assumed.
